questions.text: Follow-up to the requirement's q9 ('different levels of SaaS in certain licenses'): for each license tier, how is tenant data isolated - separate PostgreSQL database, separate schema in a shared database, or shared tables with a tenant_id column? Please list the tiers and the isolation each one gets.

Which license tier does a hospital get when it self-onboards through this application? The application form (req.md FR-1) doesn't collect a tier, so should it default to a specific tier, or should a tier selection be added to the form?

Should the tenant's database/schema be provisioned synchronously on application submission (so the Hospital Admin has full access immediately, per FR-4), or asynchronously with the admin waiting on a 'setting up' state?
